an8.78:1.1: 85 tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
an8.78:1.2: chahāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:1.4: idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:1.8: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā
an8.78:1.9: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:1.10: imehi kho āvuso chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ. 86
an8.78:2.1: pañcahāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:2.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:2.9: imehi kho āvuso pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ. 87
an8.78:3.1: catūhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.78:3.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:3.9: imehi kho āvuso catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 88
an8.78:4.1: catūhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano.
an8.78:4.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:4.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti
an8.78:4.6: no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti
an8.78:4.9: imehi kho āvuso catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano. 89
an8.78:5.1: tīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.78:5.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:5.9: imehi kho āvuso tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 90
an8.78:6.1: tīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano.
an8.78:6.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:6.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti
an8.78:6.6: no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti
an8.78:6.9: imehi kho āvuso tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano. 91
an8.78:7.1: dvīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.78:7.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:7.9: imehi kho āvuso dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 92
an8.78:8.1: dvīhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano.
an8.78:8.3: idhāvuso bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu
an8.78:8.4: no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti
an8.78:8.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti
an8.78:8.6: no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti
an8.78:8.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā
an8.78:8.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:8.9: imehi kho āvuso dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attanoti.
